analysis_basis: Per-target comparability of an NVBit-trace-derived count (re-aggregated by dynamic warp instruction + 32B sector) to the NCU hardware counter, integrating a /humanize:ask-codex count-feasibility consult. A target is engineering_closure_refuted when its NCU counter lives in an aggregation domain the per-kernel global-LSU trace cannot defensibly reach.

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: one post-predicate warp global-LSU load instruction = one request; count instructions, not active lanes
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: none for the global-LSU load request domain; the trace warp-instruction count matches the post-coalescing request count
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: replay only perturbs NCU if passes see different work/cache state; the request count itself is replay-stable

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: one post-predicate warp global-LSU store instruction = one request; do not infer from store bytes/sectors
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: none for the global-LSU store request domain
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: store write-allocation/fill behavior matters for sector counts later, not for this request count

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: one global atomic instruction = one request; the request count is comparable
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: none for the request count; atomics route through L1 toward L2
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: lane-level atomic fanout/serialization is NOT the request count and must not be inferred from it

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: one global reduction instruction = one request; the request count is comparable
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: none for the request count; same atom/reduction routing as atomics
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: reduction lane fanout/serialization is NOT the request count

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: no defensible mapping: the trace covers only the global-LSU pipe
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: the unified L1/TEX total includes non-global-LSU domains (local/shared/texture/surface) and all pipes; the trace target is global-LSU only
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: not applicable; the mismatch is the aggregation scope, not coalescing

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: no defensible mapping from per-instruction global memory accesses
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: L2 request packets from source-unit TEX/L1TEX are post-L1, whole-srcunit, and packetized -- a different aggregation domain than per-instruction global-memory trace misses
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: L2 packetization + post-L1 filtering compound; not isomorphic to the trace

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: coalesced unique 32B L1 sectors per global load request, summed; raw per-lane addresses re-aggregated to 32B sectors
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: none for the L1 access-sector domain
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: compare coalesced unique sectors, not per-lane address counts

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: coalesced unique 32B L1 store sectors per global store request, summed
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: none for the L1 store access-sector domain
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: write-allocation/fill behavior matters at the XBAR boundary, not for this L1 access-sector count

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: the L1-miss-filtered global load sector stream (xbar2l1tex read return/fill), NOT all load sectors
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: comparable ONLY after the L1 miss-stream filter; this is post-L1 return/fill traffic
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: fidelity depends on the L1 filter model; the comparison is valid only on the filtered miss stream

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: the L1->XBAR write sector stream for global stores
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: post-L1 write traffic at the L1-to-XBAR boundary
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: comparable WITH CAUTION: must model .ca/.cg store forwarding/write policy; raw L1 store sectors may over/undercount if write allocation/coalescing differs

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: no defensible mapping: per-kernel NVBit addresses cannot reach the chip-global DRAM domain
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: DRAM is chip-global and after L2 fill/eviction/compression/system traffic
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: not applicable; L2 filtering + compression + system contamination dominate

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: no defensible mapping from per-kernel store addresses
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: chip-global DRAM after L2; writeback/write-combine/allocation timing makes store trace sectors non-isomorphic to DRAM writes
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: writeback/write-combine timing is not derivable from the trace

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: comparable L1 load sectors divided by comparable L1 load requests
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: none; both numerator and denominator are L1 global-LSU load domains
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: replay mismatch can perturb NCU ratios; the trace-derived ratio is replay-stable

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: comparable L1 store sectors divided by comparable L1 store requests
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: none; do not substitute XBAR or DRAM sectors for the numerator
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: use the L1 store access-sector count, not the XBAR write count

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: sum of the comparable global-LSU load + store request counts
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: none as a global-LSU ld+st total; would be refuted only if compared to the unified l1tex__t_requests.sum
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: inherits the component request counts' replay stability

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: sum of the comparable global atomic + reduction request counts
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: none for the global-LSU atom+red request domain
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: lane-level atomic/reduction fanout is not the request count

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: sum of the comparable global-LSU load + store L1 access-sector counts
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: none as a global-LSU ld+st L1 sector total; refuted if it claimed atom/red or unified L1 sectors without matching NCU domains

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: a modeled post-L1 miss-stream total for the tracked global traffic (xbar read + L1->xbar write sectors)
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: comparable only as the modeled post-L1 miss-stream total; refuted against broad lts__*srcunit_tex* totals
targets.coalescing_replay_write_allocation_note: fidelity depends on the L1 filter model + the write-policy caveat of its write component

targets.trace_to_ncu_mapping: no defensible mapping; inherits the chip-global DRAM refutation of its read+write components
targets.aggregation_domain_mismatch: chip-global DRAM after L2; the same contamination as its components
